metadata.schedule_summary: Induction: all three medicines on Day 1 every 21 days for up to four cycles. Maintenance: paclitaxel and carboplatin stop; pembrolizumab alone may continue every 21 days while appropriate. The team agrees duration and review points.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00579 Version 5a. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

treatment.schedule_summary: Every 21 days: up to four triplet induction cycles, then pembrolizumab alone maintenance until progression/unacceptable toxicity.

phases.duration: Until progression or unacceptable toxicity; consultant plan
